uutiset.t: European Auto Sales Increase Again on Surging EV Demand
uutiset.s: European car sales rose for a ninth straight month in October, with a surge in electric-vehicle demand helping sustain a market facing record fuel prices and pressure on household budgets. Bloomberg's Elisabeth Behrmann reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.s: Oil pushed lower on cautious optimism over efforts to end the US-Iran war. Axios reports VP Vance met with Qatar’s prime minister to discuss negotiations with Iran despite President Trump’s latest threat to resume attacks next year if talks fail. uutiset.t: Tullow Jumps 20% After Settling $387 Million Ghana Tax Case
uutiset.s: Tullow Oil Plc soared 20% after the company reached a deal with Ghana to settle $387 million of tax disputes.

uutiset.t: Hong Kong’s Hedge Fund Tax Breaks Offer Boon for Pod Shop Stars
uutiset.s: Hong Kong plans to link part of its sweeping hedge fund tax breaks to the performance of individual portfolios rather than the overall returns of funds, boosting the city’s appeal to profitable managers at pod shops.

uutiset.t: Japan’s Top Life Insurers Book $7.5 Billion in Bond Sale Losses
uutiset.s: Japan’s four biggest life insurers booked more than ¥1.2 trillion ($7.5 billion) in losses from selling government and other domestic bonds in the April-September half, as they dumped debt bought when rates were low to reinvest at higher yields.

uutiset.t: JPMorgan, HSBC Trade Digital Gold in London for the First Time
uutiset.s: JPMorgan Chase & Co. and other major precious metals dealers traded a new form of digital gold in London for the first time, an early test of a system that could revamp the plumbing of the world’s biggest bullion hub.

uutiset.t: Franklin Templeton Urges Investors to Look Beyond the AI Trade
uutiset.s: Investors should look beyond the artificial intelligence trade even as Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia Corp. sparks a rebound in technology shares, according to Franklin Templeton.

uutiset.t: Dangote Clears Key Hurdle Toward Africa’s Biggest Listing
uutiset.s: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE cleared a key hurdle needed for it to start trading on Nigeria’s stock exchange as the nation’s finance watchdog approved how shares in its initial public offering will be distributed among investors.

uutiset.t: Commerzbank Weighs Partial Withdrawal From US Treasury Market
uutiset.s: Commerzbank AG is considering paring back its involvement in US Treasury trading, according to people with knowledge of the matter, as the US prepares to introduce new Treasury clearing requirements.

uutiset.t: Compass Plans New York Main Listing, Adding to London Exodus
uutiset.s: British catering firm Compass Group Plc plans to move its primary listing from London to New York, adding to the struggles of the UK stock market.

Copper Rally Fades as Demand Worries Deepen
uutiset.s: Copper erased a one-day gain sparked by Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia Corp. Prices tumbled back toward the $12,000-a-ton level in London. Bloomberg's Mark Cranfield breaks down the situation. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Emerging Market Stocks Rally as Huang’s Return Revives AI Trade
uutiset.s: Emerging-market stocks rallied the most since July as investors snapped up artificial intelligence shares after Jensen Huang’s return to lead Nvidia Corp.
